content.short: Frame provides cutting-edge infrastructure for software wallets, empowering users with secure and transparent interactions.
content.description: Privacy-focused Ethereum interface and signing device. Built organically for the Web3 ecosystem, Frame provides an essential suite of services focused heavily on software wallets. By operating on Multi-chain, it allows users to experience fast execution times while maintaining strong cryptographic security. The protocol is designed to be highly interoperable, aiming to become a cornerstone of the Web3 Wallets sector. Through continuous innovation, Frame contributes to the broader vision of a decentralized, permissionless digital economy.
content.meta: Frame is redefining software wallets on Multi-chain. Dive into detailed analytics and explore Frame directly on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
